{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (>=0.67), pull forecasts toward mean-reversion by 10-15% to correct lag",
    "When sentiment is negative (<=0.33), push forecasts 5-10% below current levels to correct overshoot",
    "Smooth forecast volatility by 20-30% using 7-day moving average on forecast values",
    "Align forecast starting point to match current price instead of using model-initialized level",
    "Reduce forecast divergence from true outcomes by 25% in the first 7-day window",
    "Adjust sentiment impact by 40% when price volatility exceeds 2.0 daily",
    "Cap individual forecast changes at 1.5 currency units per day to prevent overshooting"
] }
